description: Source code for handling streaming interactions with Anthropic AI models, including message transformation, stream management, and API client setup.

methods.name: supportsAdaptiveThinking
methods.description: Checks if the model ID supports adaptive thinking based on specific substrings.

methods.name: mapThinkingLevelToEffort
methods.description: Maps a ThinkingLevel to an effort level string, considering model ID.

methods.name: adjustMaxTokensForThinking
methods.description: Adjusts max tokens and thinking budget based on reasoning level and model constraints.

methods.name: isAnthropicOAuthToken
methods.description: Determines if an API key is an OAuth token for Anthropic.

methods.name: toClaudeCodeName
methods.description: Converts a tool name to its Claude code name using a lookup map.

methods.name: fromClaudeCodeName
methods.description: Converts Claude code name back to original tool name, considering available tools.

methods.name: convertContentBlocks
methods.description: Converts content blocks to sanitized text or image sources, adding a placeholder if needed.

methods.name: normalizeToolCallId
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates tool call IDs to a safe format.

methods.name: convertAnthropicMessages
methods.description: Transforms message objects into API-compatible message parameters.

methods.name: convertAnthropicTools
methods.description: Converts tool definitions into API-compatible tool schemas.

methods.name: mapStopReason
methods.description: Maps internal stop reasons to external string codes.

methods.name: createAnthropicTransportClient
methods.description: Creates an API client for Anthropic with appropriate headers and tokens.

methods.name: buildAnthropicParams
methods.description: Builds parameters for API requests based on model, context, and options.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicTransportOptions
methods.description: Resolves and adjusts transport options, including max tokens and thinking settings.

methods.name: createAnthropicMessagesTransportStreamFn
methods.description: Main function returning a stream handler for Anthropic message streaming.
